LESSON: PRESERVING ANIMAL PRODUCTS • MILK • MEAT

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: AGRICULTURE AND NUTRITION
Strand: Food Production Processes
Topic 2.5: Preserving animal products • Milk • Meat
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 9

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Preserving animal products • Milk • Meat, part of Food Production Processes in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8 AGRICULTURE AND NUTRITION.

Key inquiry question: How can we preserve milk and meat at household level?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Preserving animal products • Milk • Meat together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
Integrity: Honesty in the process of preserving meat and milk using ethically acceptable procedures.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Food hygiene as learners ensure use of clean tools and equipment and appropriate

environment in the preservation of meat and milk.

Link to other subjects: Learners relate preservation of meat and milk to basic principles of preservation learnt in Integrated

Science.
